Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this modern one bedroom apartment in Creek Vistas Grande, Sobha Hartland. This 747 sqft unit features a well-designed layout, quality finishing, and attractive views toward Dubai Creek Harbour.

  Located on a mid floor and currently tenanted, this apartment represents an excellent opportunity for investors seeking steady rental income within a prime and fast-growing community.
